### Beware of the Least Likely Temptation
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/updated/beware-of-the-least-likely-temptation/
Passage: 1 Kings 2:28
Points:
- Joab stayed loyal through Absalom's major rebellion, yet later defected to follow Adonijah.
- Surviving a great spiritual crisis does not make a believer immune to smaller compromises.
- Spiritual danger often strikes in subtle, seemingly improbable areas of life.
- Unguarded personal strengths can become dangerous sources of weakness.
- Continuous reliance on God's sustaining power is our only true safeguard.

### Joab and Shimei Eliminated
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/joab-and-shimei-eliminated
Passage: 1 Kings 2:33
Points:
- Joab fled to the altar seeking immunity after supporting Adonijah's coup attempt.
- David had long neglected to punish Joab's murderous deeds due to Joab's military usefulness.
- Solomon's execution of Joab at the altar illustrates the moral compromises of earthly rulers.
- The flaws of David and Solomon reveal the need for a truly righteous king.
- God's kingdom ultimately endures by His grace, not through human moral perfection.
